RCSP-220.description: End-to-end Transfers workflow covering My Hierarchy store selection, Inventory Balances validation, transfer create/submit/approve/reject, and Dashboard stock movements.

prerequisites: User is logged in to QA Backoffice Dashboard as admin
User has access to My Hierarchy, Inventory Balances, Transfers, and Dashboard

testCases.testName: Verify whether the logged-in admin user can open the My Hierarchy page from the main navigation menu
testCases.description: Verify whether the My Hierarchy page opens successfully from the main navigation menu and displays the Region, Market, and Store hierarchy selection controls.
testCases.preCondition: 1. User is logged in to QA Backoffice Dashboard as admin. 2. User is on the Home/Dashboard page.

testSteps.description: From the Home page, locate the main navigation menu on the left side or top navigation bar.
Click on the "My Hierarchy" menu option from the main navigation.
Wait for the My Hierarchy page/section to load completely.
Verify the My Hierarchy page title or section header is displayed.
Verify the hierarchy tree or selection controls for Region, Market, and Store are visible on the My Hierarchy page.

testCases.rawTestData: User Role: Admin
testCases.expectedResult: Verify whether the My Hierarchy page opens successfully from the main navigation menu and displays the Region, Market, and Store hierarchy selection controls.

testCases.testName: Verify whether the admin user can select Region, Market, and Store from the My Hierarchy page and view stores under the selected hierarchy path
testCases.description: Verify whether the user is able to navigate the hierarchy path Region -> Market -> Store on the My Hierarchy page and view both WB Unit 1034 and WB Unit 1025 under the selected Market.
testCases.preCondition: 1. User is logged in as admin. 2. User is on the My Hierarchy page.

testSteps.description: On the My Hierarchy page, locate the Region list/tree section.
Expand or select Region: "1700 San Antonio 4126314".
Verify the Market list under the selected Region is displayed.
Expand or select Market: "1708 E Central SA 4126393".
Verify the Store list under the selected Market is displayed.
Verify store "WB Unit 1034" is visible under Region -> Market -> Store hierarchy.
Verify store "WB Unit 1025" is visible under Region -> Market -> Store hierarchy.
Click on store "WB Unit 1034" to select it.
Wait for the application to apply the selected store context.

testCases.rawTestData: Region: 1700 San Antonio 4126314 | Market: 1708 E Central SA 4126393 | Stores: WB Unit 1034, WB Unit 1025
testCases.expectedResult: Verify whether the user is able to navigate the hierarchy path Region -> Market -> Store on the My Hierarchy page and view both WB Unit 1034 and WB Unit 1025 under the selected Market.

testCases.testName: Verify whether the currently selected store is displayed in the top-right corner of the Home page after selecting WB Unit 1034 from My Hierarchy
testCases.description: Verify whether the top-right corner of the Home page displays "WB Unit 1034" as the active store after the user selects WB Unit 1034 from the My Hierarchy page.
testCases.preCondition: 1. User is logged in as admin. 2. User has selected WB Unit 1034 from My Hierarchy.

testSteps.description: After selecting WB Unit 1034 on the My Hierarchy page, navigate to the Home/Dashboard page if not already redirected.
Locate the store context indicator in the top-right corner of the Home page header section.
Read and verify the displayed store name in the top-right corner.
Confirm the selected store context matches the store chosen in My Hierarchy.

testCases.rawTestData: Selected Store: WB Unit 1034
testCases.expectedResult: Verify whether the top-right corner of the Home page displays "WB Unit 1034" as the active store after the user selects WB Unit 1034 from the My Hierarchy page.

testCases.testName: Verify whether the admin user can switch the active store from WB Unit 1034 to WB Unit 1025 using the My Hierarchy page and the Home page reflects the change
testCases.description: Verify whether the active store context in the top-right corner of the Home page changes from WB Unit 1034 to WB Unit 1025 after selecting WB Unit 1025 from the My Hierarchy page.
testCases.preCondition: 1. User is logged in as admin. 2. WB Unit 1034 is currently selected.

testSteps.description: From the Home page, open the My Hierarchy page from the main navigation menu.
Navigate to Region: "1700 San Antonio 4126314".
Navigate to Market: "1708 E Central SA 4126393".
Select store "WB Unit 1025" from the Store list.
Return to the Home/Dashboard page.
Verify the top-right corner of the Home page header displays "WB Unit 1025".
Confirm the previous store context "WB Unit 1034" is no longer shown as active.

testCases.rawTestData: From Store: WB Unit 1034 | To Store: WB Unit 1025
testCases.expectedResult: Verify whether the active store context in the top-right corner of the Home page changes from WB Unit 1034 to WB Unit 1025 after selecting WB Unit 1025 from the My Hierarchy page.

testCases.testName: Verify whether the admin user can navigate to Inventory > Inventory Balances page from the main menu while WB Unit 1034 is selected
testCases.description: Verify whether the Inventory Balances page opens successfully under Inventory menu and displays the search field and inventory data grid with ON HAND and FIFO COST columns for WB Unit 1034.
testCases.preCondition: 1. User is logged in as admin. 2. WB Unit 1034 is selected and displayed in the top-right corner of the Home page.

testSteps.description: From the Home page, locate the "Inventory" menu in the main navigation.
Click on the "Inventory" menu to expand the Inventory submenu section.
Click on the "Inventory Balances" submenu option under the Inventory menu.
Wait for the Inventory Balances page to load completely.
Verify the page title or breadcrumb shows Inventory > Inventory Balances.
Verify the item search field is visible on the Inventory Balances page.
Verify the inventory grid/table with ON HAND and FIFO COST columns is visible.

testCases.rawTestData: Active Store: WB Unit 1034
testCases.expectedResult: Verify whether the Inventory Balances page opens successfully under Inventory menu and displays the search field and inventory data grid with ON HAND and FIFO COST columns for WB Unit 1034.

testCases.testName: Verify whether the ON HAND quantity and FIFO COST values are displayed correctly for item LARGE BUNS 11201 on WB Unit 1034 Inventory Balances page
testCases.description: Verify whether the Inventory Balances page for WB Unit 1034 displays the item LARGE BUNS 11201 with valid ON HAND quantity and FIFO COST values in the inventory grid.
testCases.preCondition: 1. User is logged in as admin. 2. WB Unit 1034 is selected. 3. User is on Inventory > Inventory Balances page.

testSteps.description: On the Inventory Balances page, locate the item search field in the search/filter section.
Enter item name/code "LARGE BUNS 11201" in the search field.
Execute the search by pressing Enter or clicking the Search button.
Wait for the search results to load in the inventory grid.
Locate the row for item "LARGE BUNS 11201" in the results table.
Read and record the ON HAND value displayed for LARGE BUNS
Read and record the FIFO COST value displayed for LARGE BUNS
Verify both ON HAND and FIFO COST values are populated and visible (not blank or null).

testCases.rawTestData: Store: WB Unit 1034 | Item: LARGE BUNS 11201
testCases.expectedResult: Verify whether the Inventory Balances page for WB Unit 1034 displays the item LARGE BUNS 11201 with valid ON HAND quantity and FIFO COST values in the inventory grid.

testCases.testName: Verify whether the ON HAND quantity and FIFO COST values are displayed correctly for item LARGE BUNS 11201 on WB Unit 1025 Inventory Balances page
testCases.description: Verify whether the Inventory Balances page for WB Unit 1025 displays the item LARGE BUNS 11201 with valid ON HAND quantity and FIFO COST values in the inventory grid.
testCases.preCondition: 1. User is logged in as admin. 2. WB Unit 1025 is selected in the top-right corner of the Home page. 3. User navigates to Inventory > Inventory Balances.

testSteps.description: Confirm WB Unit 1025 is displayed in the top-right corner of the Home page header.
From the Home page, navigate to Inventory > Inventory Balances.
On the Inventory Balances page, search for item "LARGE BUNS 11201" using the search field.
Wait for the search results to load.
Locate item "LARGE BUNS 11201" in the inventory results grid.
Read and record the ON HAND value for LARGE BUNS 11201 on WB Unit
Read and record the FIFO COST value for LARGE BUNS 11201 on WB Unit
Compare values with previously recorded WB Unit 1034 values if needed for baseline reference.

testCases.rawTestData: Store: WB Unit 1025 | Item: LARGE BUNS 11201
testCases.expectedResult: Verify whether the Inventory Balances page for WB Unit 1025 displays the item LARGE BUNS 11201 with valid ON HAND quantity and FIFO COST values in the inventory grid.

testCases.testName: Verify whether the Inventory Balances page displays no records or an appropriate message when searching for a non-existent item on WB Unit 1034
testCases.description: Verify whether the Inventory Balances page does not display invalid item data and shows an empty result set or a clear "No stock balances found." message when a non-existent item is searched.
testCases.preCondition: 1. User is logged in as admin. 2. WB Unit 1034 is selected. 3. User is on Inventory > Inventory Balances page.

testSteps.description: On the Inventory Balances page, locate the item search field.
Enter a non-existent item name/code "INVALID ITEM 99999" in the search field.
Execute the search.
Observe the search results section/grid on the Inventory Balances page.
Verify whether a "No stock balances found." message or empty results state is displayed.

testCases.rawTestData: Store: WB Unit 1034 | Item: INVALID ITEM 99999
testCases.expectedResult: Verify whether the Inventory Balances page does not display invalid item data and shows an empty result set or a clear "No stock balances found." message when a non-existent item is searched.

testCases.testName: Verify whether the admin user can navigate to the Transfers page from the main menu while WB Unit 1034 is selected
testCases.description: Verify whether the Transfers page opens successfully from the main navigation menu and displays the NEW TRANSFER button and transfer listing sections for WB Unit 1034.
testCases.preCondition: 1. User is logged in as admin. 2. WB Unit 1034 is selected and displayed in the top-right corner.

testSteps.description: From the Home page, locate the "Transfers" menu option in the main navigation.
Click on the "Transfers" menu.
Wait for the Transfers page to load completely.
Verify the Transfers page header/title is displayed.
Verify the "NEW TRANSFER" button is visible on the Transfers page.
Verify the Transfers page sections/tabs such as All, Draft, Pending are visible if applicable.

testCases.rawTestData: Active Store: WB Unit 1034
testCases.expectedResult: Verify whether the Transfers page opens successfully from the main navigation menu and displays the NEW TRANSFER button and transfer listing sections for WB Unit 1034.

testCases.testName: Verify whether the admin user can open the New Transfer form by clicking the NEW TRANSFER button on the Transfers page
testCases.description: Verify whether clicking the NEW TRANSFER button on the Transfers page opens the New Transfer form with all mandatory fields (From Store, To Store, Transfer Reason) and the ADD ITEM button visible.
testCases.preCondition: 1. User is logged in as admin. 2. WB Unit 1034 is selected. 3. User is on the Transfers page.

testSteps.description: On the Transfers page, locate the "NEW TRANSFER" button in the page header/action area.
Click the "NEW TRANSFER" button.
Wait for the New Transfer form/page to load.
Verify the "Select From Store *" dropdown/field is visible on the New Transfer form.
Verify the "Select To Store *" dropdown/field is visible on the New Transfer form.
Verify the "Transfer Reason *" field is visible on the New Transfer form.
Verify the "Notes" field is visible on the New Transfer form.
Verify the "ADD ITEM" button is visible on the New Transfer form.

testCases.rawTestData: Active Store: WB Unit 1034
testCases.expectedResult: Verify whether clicking the NEW TRANSFER button on the Transfers page opens the New Transfer form with all mandatory fields (From Store, To Store, Transfer Reason) and the ADD ITEM button visible.

testCases.testName: Verify whether the admin user can create a new Transfer in Draft status by filling transfer header details and adding item LARGE BUNS 11201 with quantity 1 on WB Unit 1034
testCases.description: Verify whether the new transfer from WB Unit 1034 to WB Unit 1025 with item LARGE BUNS 11201 (Qty 1 EA) is saved successfully without errors.
testCases.preCondition: 1. User is logged in as admin. 2. WB Unit 1034 is selected. 3. User is on the New Transfer form.

testSteps.description: On the New Transfer form, select "WB Unit 1034" in the "Select From Store *" field.
Select "WB Unit 1025" in the "Select To Store *" field.
Select a valid value in the "Transfer Reason *" dropdown/field.
Enter relevant text in the "Notes" field.
Click the "ADD ITEM" button on the New Transfer form.
In the Add Item section/modal, search for item "LARGE BUNS 11201".
Select item "LARGE BUNS 11201" from the search results.
Enter quantity "1" in the "Qty to Order" field with UOM "EA".
Click the "SAVE CHANGES" button on the New Transfer form.
Wait for the save confirmation or redirect.

testCases.rawTestData: From Store: WB Unit 1034 | To Store: WB Unit 1025 | Transfer Reason: <valid reason> | Notes: <valid notes> | Item: LARGE BUNS 11201 | Qty: 1 EA
testCases.expectedResult: Verify whether the new transfer from WB Unit 1034 to WB Unit 1025 with item LARGE BUNS 11201 (Qty 1 EA) is saved successfully without errors.

testCases.testName: Verify whether the recently created Transfer appears in the All section of the Transfers page with Draft status on WB Unit 1034
testCases.description: Verify whether the recently created transfer is visible in the All section of the Transfers page on WB Unit 1034 with status displayed as Draft.
testCases.preCondition: 1. User is logged in as admin. 2. WB Unit 1034 is selected. 3. A new transfer has been saved using TC_TRF_003 steps.

testSteps.description: From the New Transfer form, navigate back to the Transfers page by clicking the "Transfers" menu or breadcrumb.
On the Transfers page, verify the user lands on the "All" section/tab by default or select the "All" section.
Locate the most recently created transfer record in the transfers list/grid.
Verify the Transfer ID is displayed for the record.
Verify the From Store shows "WB Unit 1034".
Verify the To Store shows "WB Unit 1025".
Verify the Status column shows "Draft" for the recently created transfer.

testCases.rawTestData: Active Store: WB Unit 1034 | Expected Status: Draft
testCases.expectedResult: Verify whether the recently created transfer is visible in the All section of the Transfers page on WB Unit 1034 with status displayed as Draft.

testCases.testName: Verify whether the recently created Draft transfer is visible in the Draft section of the Transfers page on WB Unit 1034
testCases.description: Verify whether the recently created transfer record is listed in the Draft section of the Transfers page on WB Unit 1034.
testCases.preCondition: 1. User is logged in as admin. 2. WB Unit 1034 is selected. 3. A draft transfer exists from TC_TRF_003.

testSteps.description: On the Transfers page for WB Unit 1034, locate the section/tab filters (All, Draft, Pending, etc.).
Click on the "Draft" section/tab on the Transfers page.
Wait for the Draft transfers list to load.
Locate the recently created transfer record in the Draft section list.
Verify the Transfer ID matches the draft created in the previous step.
Verify the status is displayed as "Draft".
Verify From Store and To Store values are correct.

testCases.rawTestData: Active Store: WB Unit 1034 | Expected Status: Draft
testCases.expectedResult: Verify whether the recently created transfer record is listed in the Draft section of the Transfers page on WB Unit 1034.

testCases.testName: Verify whether clicking a Draft transfer record opens the Draft Details page with CANCEL, SAVE CHANGES, and SUBMIT TRANSFER action buttons on WB Unit 1034
testCases.description: Verify whether the Draft Details page opens with complete transfer details and displays CANCEL, SAVE CHANGES, and SUBMIT TRANSFER buttons for the selected Draft transfer on WB Unit 1034.
testCases.preCondition: 1. User is logged in as admin. 2. WB Unit 1034 is selected. 3. A draft transfer is visible in the Draft section.

testSteps.description: On the Transfers page, switch to the "Draft" section/tab.
Click on the recently created Draft transfer record from the list.
Wait for the Draft Details page to load.
Verify the Draft Details page displays transfer header information (From Store, To Store, Reason, Notes).
Verify the added item "LARGE BUNS 11201" with Qty 1 EA is displayed in the items section.
Verify the "CANCEL" button is visible and enabled on the Draft Details page.
Verify the "SAVE CHANGES" button is visible and enabled on the Draft Details page.
Verify the "SUBMIT TRANSFER" button is visible and enabled on the Draft Details page.

testCases.rawTestData: Active Store: WB Unit 1034 | Transfer Status: Draft
testCases.expectedResult: Verify whether the Draft Details page opens with complete transfer details and displays CANCEL, SAVE CHANGES, and SUBMIT TRANSFER buttons for the selected Draft transfer on WB Unit 1034.

testCases.testName: Verify whether the admin user can submit a Draft transfer and the transfer status changes to Pending on WB Unit 1034
testCases.description: Verify whether clicking SUBMIT TRANSFER on the Draft Details page successfully submits the transfer and changes the status from Draft to Pending on the Transfers page for WB Unit 1034.
testCases.preCondition: 1. User is logged in as admin. 2. WB Unit 1034 is selected. 3. User is on the Draft Details page for a Draft transfer.

testSteps.description: On the Draft Details page, review the transfer details (From: WB Unit 1034, To: WB Unit 1025, Item: LARGE BUNS 11201, Qty: 1).
Click the "SUBMIT TRANSFER" button on the Draft Details page.
Wait for the submission process to complete.
Verify the user is redirected to the Transfers page.
On the Transfers page, locate the submitted transfer record by Transfer ID.
Verify the Status column shows "Pending" for the submitted transfer.
Verify the transfer is no longer listed under the Draft section.

testCases.rawTestData: Active Store: WB Unit 1034 | Expected Status after submit: Pending
testCases.expectedResult: Verify whether clicking SUBMIT TRANSFER on the Draft Details page successfully submits the transfer and changes the status from Draft to Pending on the Transfers page for WB Unit 1034.

testCases.testName: Verify whether a Pending transfer sent from WB Unit 1034 is visible on the Transfers page when viewed from WB Unit 1025 with Reject and Approve action buttons
testCases.description: Verify whether the Pending transfer initiated from WB Unit 1034 is visible on the Transfers page of WB Unit 1025 with Reject and Approve action buttons available.
testCases.preCondition: 1. User is logged in as admin. 2. A transfer from WB Unit 1034 to WB Unit 1025 is in Pending status.

testSteps.description: Switch active store to WB Unit 1025 using My Hierarchy (confirm top-right corner shows WB Unit 1025).
From the Home page, click on the "Transfers" menu in the main navigation.
On the Transfers page for WB Unit 1025, locate the Pending transfer by Transfer ID.
Verify the transfer From Store shows "WB Unit 1034".
Verify the transfer To Store shows "WB Unit 1025".
Verify the Status shows "Pending".
Verify the ACTIONS column displays "Reject" and "Approve" buttons for the Pending transfer.

testCases.rawTestData: Active Store: WB Unit 1025 | Transfer Status: Pending | From: WB Unit 1034 | To: WB Unit 1025
testCases.expectedResult: Verify whether the Pending transfer initiated from WB Unit 1034 is visible on the Transfers page of WB Unit 1025 with Reject and Approve action buttons available.

testCases.testName: Verify whether the destination store user can reject a Pending transfer with a reason and the transfer status changes to Declined on WB Unit 1025
testCases.description: Verify whether rejecting a Pending transfer with a valid reason on WB Unit 1025 changes the transfer status to Declined and the rejection modal behaves as expected.
testCases.preCondition: 1. User is logged in as admin. 2. WB Unit 1025 is selected. 3. A Pending transfer from WB Unit 1034 to WB Unit 1025 exists.

testSteps.description: On the Transfers page for WB Unit 1025, locate the Pending transfer record.
In the ACTIONS column, click the "Reject" button for the Pending transfer.
Verify a confirmation modal opens with title/message "Reject this transfer?" and description "This will mark the transfer as declined."
Verify the modal contains a mandatory "Reason *" input field.
Verify the modal displays "NO" and "YES" buttons.
Enter a valid rejection reason in the "Reason *" field (e.g., "Incorrect quantity").
Click the "YES" button on the rejection modal.
Wait for the rejection to process.
On the Transfers page, locate the same Transfer ID.
Verify the Status column shows "Declined".

testCases.rawTestData: Active Store: WB Unit 1025 | Rejection Reason: Incorrect quantity | Expected Status: Declined
testCases.expectedResult: Verify whether rejecting a Pending transfer with a valid reason on WB Unit 1025 changes the transfer status to Declined and the rejection modal behaves as expected.

testData.modalDescription: This will mark the transfer as declined.

testCases.testName: Verify whether the Reject Transfer modal prevents rejection when the mandatory Reason field is left blank on WB Unit 1025
testCases.description: Verify whether the Reject Transfer modal displays mandatory field validation and does not change the transfer status to Declined when the Reason field is empty.
testCases.preCondition: 1. User is logged in as admin. 2. WB Unit 1025 is selected. 3. A Pending transfer exists on the Transfers page.

testSteps.description: On the Transfers page for WB Unit 1025, click the "Reject" button for a Pending transfer.
Verify the "Reject this transfer?" modal opens.
Leave the "Reason *" field blank.
Click the "YES" button on the modal.
Observe validation behavior on the modal.
Verify the transfer status remains "Pending" if rejection is blocked.

testCases.rawTestData: Active Store: WB Unit 1025 | Reason: (blank) | Expected Status: Pending
testCases.expectedResult: Verify whether the Reject Transfer modal displays mandatory field validation and does not change the transfer status to Declined when the Reason field is empty.

testCases.testName: Verify whether a Declined transfer status is reflected on the Transfers page when viewed from the source store WB Unit 1034
testCases.description: Verify whether the transfer rejected on WB Unit 1025 is displayed with Declined status on the Transfers page when viewed from the source store WB Unit 1034.
testCases.preCondition: 1. User is logged in as admin. 2. A transfer from WB Unit 1034 to WB Unit 1025 was rejected and marked Declined on WB Unit 1025.

testSteps.description: Switch active store to WB Unit 1034 using My Hierarchy (confirm top-right corner shows WB Unit 1034).
From the Home page, click on the "Transfers" menu.
On the Transfers page for WB Unit 1034, search or locate the same Transfer ID that was rejected.
Verify the Status column shows "Declined" for that transfer record.
Verify From Store and To Store details remain correct.

testCases.rawTestData: Active Store: WB Unit 1034 | Expected Status: Declined
testCases.expectedResult: Verify whether the transfer rejected on WB Unit 1025 is displayed with Declined status on the Transfers page when viewed from the source store WB Unit 1034.

testCases.testName: Verify whether the admin user can create and directly submit a new Transfer from WB Unit 1034 to WB Unit 1025 without saving as Draft
testCases.description: Verify whether a new transfer created on WB Unit 1034 can be submitted directly using SUBMIT TRANSFER and appears on the Transfers page with Pending status.
testCases.preCondition: 1. User is logged in as admin. 2. WB Unit 1034 is selected. 3. Previous declined transfer exists (does not block new transfer).

testSteps.description: On the Transfers page for WB Unit 1034, click the "NEW TRANSFER" button.
On the New Transfer form, select From Store: "WB Unit 1034".
Select To Store: "WB Unit 1025".
Select a valid Transfer Reason.
Enter Notes.
Click the "ADD ITEM" button.
Search and select item "LARGE BUNS 11201".
Enter Qty to Order: "1" with UOM "EA".
Click the "SUBMIT TRANSFER" button directly (without clicking SAVE CHANGES).
Wait for submission to complete.
Verify the user lands on the Transfers page.
Locate the new transfer record and verify Status shows "Pending".

testCases.rawTestData: From Store: WB Unit 1034 | To Store: WB Unit 1025 | Item: LARGE BUNS 11201 | Qty: 1 EA | Expected Status: Pending
testCases.expectedResult: Verify whether a new transfer created on WB Unit 1034 can be submitted directly using SUBMIT TRANSFER and appears on the Transfers page with Pending status.

testCases.testName: Verify whether the destination store user can approve a Pending transfer and the transfer status changes to Completed on WB Unit 1025
testCases.description: Verify whether approving a Pending transfer on WB Unit 1025 changes the transfer status to Completed after confirming the Approve modal.
testCases.preCondition: 1. User is logged in as admin. 2. WB Unit 1025 is selected. 3. A Pending transfer from WB Unit 1034 to WB Unit 1025 exists.

testSteps.description: On the Transfers page for WB Unit 1025, locate the Pending transfer by Transfer ID.
In the ACTIONS column, click the "Approve" button.
Verify a confirmation modal opens with message "Approve this transfer?" and description "Completes the transfer and moves inventory to the destination."
Verify the modal displays "NO" and "YES" buttons.
Click the "YES" button on the approval modal.
Wait for the approval process to complete.
On the Transfers page, locate the same Transfer ID.
Verify the Status column shows "Completed".

testCases.rawTestData: Active Store: WB Unit 1025 | Expected Status: Completed
testCases.expectedResult: Verify whether approving a Pending transfer on WB Unit 1025 changes the transfer status to Completed after confirming the Approve modal.

testData.modalDescription: Completes the transfer and moves inventory to the destination.

testCases.description: Verify whether the Dashboard > Recent Stock Movements section on WB Unit 1025 displays a Transfer In record for LARGE BUNS with quantity +1 and the correct date/time after transfer approval.

Verify the ITEM column shows "LARGE BUNS".
Verify the QTY column shows "+1".
Verify the DATE column displays the current transfer completion date and time (e.g., Jul 9, 2026, 7:13 PM).

testCases.expectedResult: Verify whether the Dashboard > Recent Stock Movements section on WB Unit 1025 displays a Transfer In record for LARGE BUNS with quantity +1 and the correct date/time after transfer approval.

testCases.description: Verify whether the ON HAND quantity for LARGE BUNS 11201 on WB Unit 1034 Inventory Balances page is decremented by 1 after the transfer is approved and completed.

Navigate to Inventory > Inventory Balances from the main menu.
Search for item "LARGE BUNS 11201" on the Inventory Balances page.
Read the current ON HAND value for LARGE BUNS
